structured_output.what_is_happening: $merci ("from crime szn to merci szn") is a pump.fun cult coin. It launched about 24 minutes before migration, graduated to PumpSwap around 20:25Z, and did about $760k of volume in 30 minutes from 2,526 unique buyers. It peaked at about $453k market cap (packet ath_price) and is now at about $254k, down 26-36% in the last 5 minutes. Its site (merciszn.fun) describes a pay-to-shill model: promote $merci, switch your profile picture to the merci cat, and get paid. It is tied to the X account @mercicult. At least 10 copycat 'merci' tokens launched within minutes, and this one is the earliest and the largest.

narrative.description: A 'gratitude cult' meme that rewrites 'crime' as 'merci' (thank you), with a cat profile-picture campaign and rewards for people who shill and adopt the PFP. It is a CT-native cult/community-mechanic narrative, not tied to an outside news event.
narrative.why_spreading: Paying people to shill and change their PFP creates visible spread on X, but that spread is paid, not organic. The copycat swarm shows traders noticed it fast. I found no outside cultural event it refers to.

token_connection.why_this_token: It is the earliest pair (created 1790367949000, before every listed copycat), has the highest market cap and liquidity, and has the project site and @mercicult X account attached in GMGN and GeckoTerminal.
token_connection.competing_tokens: About 10 same-name copies launched within 25 minutes (HE3sA1…, 9UpKDi…, 3jRqZf…, etc.). Several already have near-zero liquidity. HE3sA1 has $386k h1 volume and is soaking up some flow.

authenticity.evidence: The project site says it pays people to shill and change their PFP. GMGN tags 373 bundler wallets, 702 fresh wallets and a 71% bot/degen rate, and the top bundler traders hold 25.5%. The dev has closed out (creator_close, 0% held). On the other side, 36 smart wallets and 2 renowned wallets are present, there are no paid DexScreener boosts, and 2,526 unique buyers is a broad base.
authenticity.uncertainty: The X thread returned HTTP 402, so I could not see its engagement. Web search found nothing about merci szn or the contract.

structural_risks: The price is already down about 44% from its $453k ATH and still falling fast (-34% m5); a 2x from entry needs a new ATH of about $500k+
The pay-to-shill model can create steady sell pressure from paid promoters

structured_output.counterargument: Cult coins with PFP campaigns and fast copycat swarms are exactly the ones that retrace 40-50% after migration and then send to $1M+. There are 2,500+ unique buyers in 30 minutes, smart wallets are present, LP is 100% burned, top-10 holders own only 17%, and the coin is clearly the canonical one. A dip entry after a shakeout could 2x on a second leg if the X campaign keeps going.
unknowns: Engagement on @mercicult posts and how widely the PFP campaign has spread
Who is funding the shill payouts and how big they are
Whether the -34% m5 is a shakeout or the start of a distribution phase
The 'crime szn' reference: I could not find what it points to

source_coverage.notes: The X status returned HTTP 402. Web searches for the contract, $merci and merci szn returned nothing relevant. The project site loaded. The time budget was tight, so I did not search Telegram or Discord.

structured_output.thesis: This is the canonical coin of a fast-starting cult meme with real breadth (2.5k buyers, 16x turnover), but I am entering after the top: it is down about 44% from ATH and still dumping. Bundlers and bots are heavy, the dev has exited, and the demand is paid-shill driven. A 2x needs a new high. It has somewhat better odds than a typical pool coin because it is canonical and has momentum, but it is more likely to chop or hit the -50% stop.
